text:
carol.nguyen: Quick heads-up — SOC2 fieldwork window got moved to Dec 3-5 (audit team asked). We need to reconcile HSM onboarding/access + a prod key-rotation smoke test during that window. Who owns the HSM access checklist and who can take the test slot scheduling?

sam.patel: I can own HSM access for infra (staging + prod gate). I'll need eng-runtime to freeze key rotation cron during the smoke window.

maria.lopez: I can do the freeze and coordinate the rotation test. Proposed approach: do a non-destructive rotation against a mirrored key in staging, then one canary rotation in prod at low-traffic hour.

kevin.chen: Audit ask: we need syslog forwarding to the audit collector for the HSM ops during the test and evidence of KMS/HSM admin RBAC changes. Please record all console sessions.

carol.nguyen: @sam.patel and @maria.lopez — can you both confirm owners for the runbook sections? I'll update the SOC2 tracker. Also need a CR for the runbook edits (policy + steps).

sam.patel: Confirmed — infra owns access list + provisioning steps. I'll also add the list of required approvals (sec lead + oncall).

maria.lopez: Confirmed — runtime owns the actual rotation steps and smoke harness. Pushing a runbook PR now. Ping me on the PR for quick review.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window set by carol.nguyen for 2025-12-03 02:00-04:00 UTC (tags: SOC2-fieldwork, HSM-smoke).

carol.nguyen: Nice. Maria — can you paste the minimal smoke command we should run so security/infra can validate the logs? auditor will want the exact commands in evidence.

maria.lopez: Sure — paste below (staging mirror):

```bash
# validate key material binding (no rotation applied to prod key)
ssh -i /secrets/hsm-admin.pem ops@staging-hsm01 \n  "hsmctl test-binding --key-id mirror-key-2025 --nonce $(date +%s)"

# dry-run rotation (no promote)
hsmctl rotate --key-id mirror-key-2025 --dry-run --output json
```

maria.lopez: For prod canary (low traffic):

```bash
# promote rotated key to canary slot
hsmctl rotate --key-id prod-key-2025 --canary --approve-by carol.nguyen,sam.patel --notify '#eng-oncall'
```

kevin.chen: Perfect. Please ensure the syslog-forwarder is enabled before these commands and capture the session transcript. I will add the audit evidence checklist item in the tracker.

carol.nguyen: Action items: 
- sam.patel: add provisioning & RBAC changes to infra checklist (due Nov 25)
- maria.lopez: open runbook PR + smoke commands in PR description (due Nov 27)
- kevin.chen: add syslog & session capture evidence items to SOC2 tracker (due Nov 26)

sam.patel: noted, I'll also schedule a 30-min dry run with runtime next Tue (Nov 26) to validate steps.

maria.lopez: I'll review infra changes during the dry run and update the PR.

kevin.chen: I'll review the collected logs after dry run and confirm retention / integrity hashes.

carol.nguyen: Thanks team. One more ask — if anyone needs HSM operator access exceptions, route through the approvals doc I attached earlier. We'll need recorded approval emails for auditor. :white_check_mark:

sam.patel: ack :+1:

maria.lopez: ack, will ping on PR when ready.

kevin.chen: ack, will watch for evidence uploads.

carol.nguyen: Closing loop here — tagging owners in the SOC2 tracker and moving milestone to "preflight scheduled." If anything blocks, drop quick notes in this thread.

oncall-bot: carol.nguyen added tag SOC2-preflight to milestone #87
